- Whitey Ford: 1973 BBWAA—255 of 380 votes, 285 needed, not inducted; 1974 BBWAA—284 of 365 votes, 274 needed, inducted.
- Sal Maglie: 1964 BBWAA—13 of 201 votes, 151 needed, not inducted; 1968 BBWAA—11 of 283 votes, 213 needed, not inducted.
- Don Newcombe: 16 records, all without induction—1966 BBWAA (7 votes); 1967 Run Off (2); 1967 BBWAA (18); 1968 (9); 1969 (3); 1970 (5); 1971 (8); 1972 (7); 1973 (11); 1974 (7); 1975 (11); 1976 (21); 1977 (43); 1978 (48); 1979 (52); and 1980 (59). All except the runoff were BBWAA ballots.
- Warren Spahn: 1958 BBWAA—1 of 266 votes, 200 needed, not inducted; 1973 BBWAA—316 of 380 votes, 285 needed, inducted.
